name: @neoverse-ui/tailwind
description: Tailwind CSS v4 semantic theme and component styles for Neoverse UI.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun run build:theme && tailwindcss -i ./src/consumer.css -o ./dist/index.css --minify && tailwindcss -i ./src/index.css -o ./dist/playground.css --minify
scripts.test: bun run --filter @neoverse-ui/tokens build && bun run --filter @neoverse-ui/motion build && bun run build:theme && tailwindcss -i ./src/contract.css -o ./dist/contract.css --minify && bun ./scripts/assert-contract.ts
